games.name: surf
games.desc:
HOW TO SURF:
1. Board the surf parallel to the surface
2. Look straight towards the end of the surf
3. Hold A on the right side of a surf (   /\ A)
4. Hold D on the left side of a surf (D /\   )
5. DO NOT press W while surfing.
6. Look towards the spine to move up the surf
7. Look towards the bottom to move down the surf
8. At the end of the surf, flick towards the spine to launch yourself
    across the gap and air strafe to the next surf

How to air strafe:
1. Hold D while turning right.
2. Hold A while turning left.
3. DO NOT press W while in the air.

Please help teach new players how to play the game!

Say !tutorial for a text-based tutorial.
